title: New emphasis/lane demo directives truncate pipe ids with u32(fid) — ids >= 2^32 silently wrap onto a different (possibly live) pipe
detail: strconv.parse_uint returns u64; pipe = u32(fid) silently truncates ids >= 2^32, so e.g. 4294967297 targets pipe 1. Bus validation (.Missing_Pipe) only catches non-live ids; a wrapped id can hit a live pipe and apply emphasis silently instead of failing loud. Same inherited pattern as base draw/spawn/demolish, and the era directive does range-check (v > 255), so this is a note, not a blocker.
recommended_fix: Range-check before narrowing like the era directive: reject fid > max u32 (or > pipe count) in parse_demo so out-of-range pipe ids fail loud instead of wrapping.
